name: New quote standard pricing (full waterfall)
what_it_tests: A brand-new quote line (QuoteTypeText != Renewal, action Add/null) runs the full catalog + attribute + discount waterfall, stamps contributor base, and is eligible for services regional pricing; no asset inheritance, no COLA
proc_mechanism: Manual Quote Level Discount (ItemSalesTransactionAction 'Add' OR IsNull) AND non-derived; Stamp Base Filter (QuoteTypeText NotEquals 'Renewal'); start-date defaulting rules
expected_behavior: Full pricing waterfall; contributor base stamped; full list applied; subject to new-sale approval matrix
test_setup: QuoteTypeText='New', ItemSalesTransactionAction='Add', new customer (e.g. Terranova SAT 1000-user annual), Qty=5

prior_run.actual: After 3 Force-reprices NetUnitPrice=0, NetTotalPrice=0, Subtotal=0, PricingTermCount=null; UnitPrice=20500 held, ListPrice=20500. Identical PSM Subscription-type 5250 Integrator priced net=2021.25 PTC=1. Org-wide 0 Software-type QLIs have net>0; 22 have net=0.
prior_run.defectStep: Subscription Pricing (V21 steps 110-112) consuming null PricingTermCount on a TermDefined line; Term-Defined proration PTC-stamp (steps 97/121/123 Proration / Term-Defined proration filter) only fires on the Subscription product-type / Subscription Aggregate path, so Fortra_Product_Type__c='Software' TermDefined lines never get PTC stamped -> net = InputUnitPrice x null = 0.
prior_run.notes: F-01 catalog premise (Cyber Software One-Time/Perpetual) is unsatisfiable in UAT: no Software-type product has a OneTime selling model; Software-type products are TermDefined-only and all price to $0 net. Same V21 reprice prices a Subscription-type TermDefined line correctly (net=list, PTC=1), isolating product-type, not selling-model/proration/PSM, as the differentiator. Fixture SubscriptionTerm 12->1 made no difference; root is the PTC stamp gating. REST place reprice returned isSuccess=true with empty errorResponse each time (silent $0, no gack).
